# SEM SW Ticket System Project Instructions

Scope: this repository only. Read alongside [Common Instructions](../AGENTS.md).

## Application Ownership

- This is the ticket-system application, not the canonical web template.
- Maintain template-based composition and keep ticket contracts, business decisions, and UI application-owned.
- Keep internal application data isolated from external or read-only sources.
- Verify features in code and tests before defining states, permissions, assignment, or approval rules.
- Starter dashboards and template documentation do not establish implemented ticket workflows.
- Define DTOs and backend contracts before frontend feature changes; reuse platform capabilities.

## Feature References

- Use [Repository Overview](../README.md) for setup; verify template-derived status claims against current code.
- Record confirmed ticket-feature rules here or in linked Markdown documents as features are implemented.
